$comment: PB6: upstream weights Revelei exports to ONNX, each URL fetched and its license read on 2026-10-19. sha256 is the upstream's own where it publishes one (Hugging Face LFS) and computed from the downloaded file otherwise; size is bytes. scripts/download_models.py (PB7) reads this file. No weights live in the repository.

models.name: realesrgan-x2plus
models.note: A native 2x model, so 2x need not be 4x followed by a downscale.

models.name: gfpgan-v1.4
models.note: The same asset is also attached to release v1.3.0. Apache-2.0 except third-party components: StyleGAN2-derived code under the NVIDIA Source Code License (non-commercial: research or evaluation only) and DFDNet-derived code under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Treat commercial use as not cleared.

models.name: rmbg-1.4
models.note: Not gated. Pinned to repository commit 2ceba5a5. Commercial use needs a license from BRIA; the README and the About page must say so. Used to verify the upstream ONNX export below.

models.name: rmbg-1.4-onnx
models.note: BRIA's own ONNX export: opset 11, input batch x 3 x 1024 x 1024 (pixels / 255 - 0.5), output the sigmoid mask. export-and-quantize.py adopts it after checking it against the PyTorch weights.

models.name: rmbg-1.4-arch
models.note: The BriaRMBG architecture, downloaded rather than vendored because it is under BRIA's license. export-and-quantize.py loads it with its transformers base class replaced by nn.Module.

models.name: yunet-2023mar
models.note: PB30: the face detector GFPGAN's crops come from, fetched on 2026-10-20 and pinned to the opencv_zoo commit that added it. Already ONNX (opset 11): 1 x 3 x 640 x 640 BGR pixels 0 to 255, out per-stride heads (8, 16, 32) with a box and five landmarks per face. Chosen over facexlib's RetinaFace, which has no upstream ONNX and is 100 MB.

models.name: scunet-color-real-psnr
models.note: PB36: SCUNet for real-world photo noise (the PSNR-trained one, not the GAN one, so it removes noise rather than inventing texture). The asset SCUNet's README links, fetched on 2026-10-20; the architecture is vendored from SCUNet commit 52e440a into scripts/archs/scunet.py. Chosen over NAFNet, whose weights are only on Google Drive.

models.name: vitmatte-small-composition-1k
models.note: PB48: ViTMatte (ViT-S backbone, trained on Composition-1k), the matting model that sharpens RMBG-1.4's unsure edge from a trimap. The owner approved the extra download on 2026-10-20. Pinned to repository commit 6a58ad76; the code is MIT (github.com/hustvl/ViTMatte), the weights Apache-2.0. export-and-quantize.py builds it through transformers, so no architecture is vendored.

models.name: vitmatte-small-composition-1k-config
models.note: The configuration transformers builds ViTMatte from, beside its weights.

models.name: u2net
models.note: Permissive fallback for background removal if RMBG-1.4's non-commercial license is unacceptable. Already ONNX. Not part of the default download until it is chosen.

$comment_test_images: PB10: the fixed images export-and-quantize.py checks INT8 and FP16 against FP32 on, one per model, each the upstream's own sample input. Downloaded into test-images/ beside the weights; never committed.

test_images.name: image-gfpgan
test_images.note: An aligned 512x512 face crop, which is what GFPGAN sees.

test_images.name: image-faces
test_images.note: PB30: a whole photo with a face in it, which the detector must find and align.

test_images.name: image-scunet
test_images.note: PB36: one of SCUNet's own real noisy photos, the denoiser's validation input.
